title: DividendSummary
description:
One ISIN's dividend income, summed lifetime and per Indian financial year. DERIVED, NEVER STORED -- recomputed from DIVIDEND transactions (docs/DATA_MODEL.md's txn_type table: qty=0, price=0, amount in dividend_amount). Source of truth: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 4, which already counts DIVIDEND as a positive XIRR cash flow; this object is the display aggregation over those same rows.

An ISIN that has never recorded a DIVIDEND row simply has no entry -- a true, known zero, not a value substituted for one that is missing (contrast CLAUDE.md rule 4, which forbids defaulting an UNPRICED holding to zero).

total.description: Sum of dividend_amount across every DIVIDEND row for this ISIN, all financial years combined.

fy.description: Indian financial year, April-to-March, e.g. "2025-26" for 1 April 2025 - 31 March 2026 -- same label app.routers.transactions._financial_year_bounds parses for the /realised?fy= filter.
